page.layout: One page of text, one column, with arithmetic displays set within it. Running head at top, page number at top right. Gathering signature "A" at foot centre. No margin notes.

main_text.l: 5 à 14 remanent 9, quae supra scribo, 4 à 5 re-
manet unum, quod sequenti notae praepo-
no, & pergo dicens, 5 à 14 remanent 9, quae
tos triginta quatuor aureos: Et tu solvisti
Et dico 2 à 3 remanet 1, quod supra scri-
remanent 3, quae supra noto: o à 4 rema-
nent 4, quae supra scribo. Subductio sic est:

page.notes: Display lines of the subtraction and addition examples are set as printed, with the small dot marks between digits in the subtraction lines (7 ·4, 5 ·4) and the superscript borrow marks above the first digits, which are not reproduced exactly. Long s in "Expofuit" is read as a long s, so the word is given as "Exposuit". The tilde over the u of "primũ" is rendered as ū. The mark above "Quaeritur" is a decorative flourish and is not transcribed.
